title: Tilemap Editor
prompt:
Build a tile-map editor: a 20x15 grid drawn on the canvas and a palette of at least 5 tile ids (0 = empty, 1-4 or more = terrain such as grass, water, stone, sand). Tools: paint (selected tile), erase (0) and fill (flood the 4-connected region sharing the clicked cell's value with the selected tile). Each apply, fill or drag stroke is one undo step (keep 50); a new edit clears redo. score = non-empty cells. start() opens an empty map with the paint tool and tile 1; the editor never reaches 'over'. exportMap() returns JSON {cols, rows, tiles}; save() and load() use localStorage key 'kyora-tilemap'. Mouse or touch: press and drag paints every cell under the pointer, start cell included, immediately. Keyboard: B paint, E erase, F fill, Digit1-Digit9 select tiles, Z undo, Y redo.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, cols:20, rows:15, tool:'paint'|'erase'|'fill', tile, tileCount, tiles (tiles[y][x]), undoDepth, redoDepth}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.setTool(name): 'paint', 'erase' or 'fill'
- Game.input.selectTile(i): select a palette tile
- Game.input.apply(x, y): use the current tool on a cell
- Game.undo(): returns false when there is nothing to undo
- Game.redo(): returns false when there is nothing to redo
- Game.exportMap(): JSON string
- Game.importMap(json): returns false and changes nothing on invalid input
- Game.save(): returns true
- Game.load(): returns false without a save
- Game.cellCenter(x, y): canvas point of a cell

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): paint, erase, fill, undo/redo, export/import, save/load, click, drag, shortcuts.
